decision.explanation: Q01 is broadly most similar to C03 (magnet_fracture). The Welch ranking favors C03 by a small margin over C04, and the exact 5.3 Hz dominant component plus the visibly periodic 10 s evolution supports that choice. C04 mainly matches the high-frequency carrier and short-lag periodicity, but its 50 Hz low-frequency leader and much stronger >8 kHz allocation conflict.
